This '''unidentified individual''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], this individual was serving alongside [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] when [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was initiated. Evading the initial onslaught, they traveled to [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] to meet with other survivors. While fleeing the planet aboard an [[SX troop transport|SX troop shuttle]], this Jedi was mortally wounded an died on board.

==Biography==
Serving the Order when tensions between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] came to a breaking point, this Jedi reported to Coruscant at the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and received the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. When the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] disbanded the Jedi Order with the issuance of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], this Jedi was surrounded by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who opened fire without apparent cause. Managing to escape, this Jedi responded to [[Iwo Kulka]]'s [[Emergency Code Nine Thirteen/Legends|distress call]] on [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] where they met with eight other Jedi survivors. Hijacking an [[SX troop transport|SX troop shuttle]] in order to escape the world, the Jedi were attacked by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The resulting firefight took the life of this Jedi and three others. Their body was taken on board the smuggler ship, the ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' after having died in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="DL" />
